shared_elements: carved stone relief panel with figural scene
human head with hair/wig rendered in profile
justification: Both depict human figures in strict profile in low relief, and both include a figure seated with an extended arm, which is a real but broadly generic correspondence. A shows a single large-scale figure filling the whole field with heavy modelled volumes and a plain base band, while B shows a small-scale multi-figure scene divided into two registers with a seated figure before an offering table and columns of sign-like markings — a different compositional scheme and a much more linear, incised, schematic manner.
